# Clinical trial cohort analysis 

# JAVELIN-101 

TO DO: Check details of inclusion criteria / treatments (PDL1+VEGFi vs. Sunitib) / tumor location etc. / pretreatment samples? 

```{r}
# TPM matrix 
tpm_mat <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/validation/CTcohorts/SuppInfo_Jammihal_NatCancer25.xlsx", sheet = 4)
tpm_mat <- tpm_mat %>% column_to_rownames("hgnc_symbol")

# Clinical data
clin <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/validation/CTcohorts/SuppInfo_Jammihal_NatCancer25.xlsx", sheet = 2)
clin_sub <- clin[clin$UUID %in% colnames(tpm_mat),]
rownames(clin_sub) <- clin_sub$UUID

tpm_mat <- tpm_mat[, rownames(clin_sub)]
```

```{r}
# Create SummarizedExperiment
se <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays = list(tpm = as.matrix(tpm_mat)),
  colData = clin_sub,
  rowData = DataFrame(gene = rownames(tpm_mat), row.names = rownames(tpm_mat))
)

se
```


```{r}
# Nearest template prediction
library(CMScaller)

# Step 1: Prepare expression matrix (genes x samples, log2 scale)
tpm_mat <- assays(se)$tpm
log2_tpm <- log2(tpm_mat + 1)
expr_mat <- ematAdjust(log2_tpm, method = "RLE")
rownames(expr_mat) <- rowData(se)$gene

# Step 2: Create subtype templates (Gene signatures)
names(MTORUP) <- rep("MTOR", length(MTORUP))
names(ICAMUP) <- rep("ICAM", length(ICAMUP))
keyup <- c(MTORUP, ICAMUP)

template_mat <- data.frame(class = factor(names(keyup)), 
           probe = unname(keyup))

# Step 3: Run NTP classification with permutations
ntp_result <- ntp(
  emat = expr_mat,           
  template = template_mat,
  distance = "cosine",
  nPerm = 1000,              
  seed = 22,                 
  nCores = 30,
  doPlot = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
ntp_out <- ntp_result %>% rownames_to_column("PID") %>% mutate(group_predict = ifelse(FDR < 0.01, as.character(prediction), "NOT"))

ntp_out$OS_months <- se$OS[match(ntp_out$PID, se$UUID)]
ntp_out$status_OS <- se$OS_CNSR[match(ntp_out$PID, se$UUID)]
ntp_out$PFS_months <- se$PFS[match(ntp_out$PID, se$UUID)]
ntp_out$status_PFS <- se$PFS_CNSR[match(ntp_out$PID, se$UUID)]
ntp_out$treatment <- se$Treatment[match(ntp_out$PID, se$UUID)]
ntp_out$location <- se$Tumor_Location[match(ntp_out$PID, se$UUID)]

# Combined
fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ group_predict, data = ntp_out)
print(fit)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme¨

          conf.int = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
se$TME_archetype <- ntp_out$group_predict[match(se$UUID, ntp_out$PID)]
```


```{r}
library(survival)
library(dplyr)

# Prepare the survival dataframe
Cox_df <- as.data.frame(colData(se)) %>%
  dplyr::select(UUID, TME_archetype, Treatment, Tumor_Location) %>% 
  #filter(Tumor_Location == "METASTATIC") %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("TKI", "IO+VEGF")),
    PFS_months = se$PFS[match(UUID, se$UUID)],
    status_PFS = se$PFS_CNSR[match(UUID, se$UUID)]
  )

# List of TME groups (e.g., ICAM, MTOR, NOT)
tme_groups <- unique(Cox_df$TME_archetype)

# Run Cox model per TME group
cox_results <- lapply(tme_groups, function(group) {
  df_group <- Cox_df %>% filter(TME_archetype == group & !is.na(Treatment))
  model <- coxph(Surv(PFS_months, status_PFS) ~ Treatment, data = df_group)
  summary(model)
  })

names(cox_results) <- tme_groups

plot_df_prop <- rbind(data.frame(group = rownames(cox_results[[1]]$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(cox_results[[1]]$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(cox_results[[1]]$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(cox_results[[1]]$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(cox_results[[1]]$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(cox_results[[1]]$waldtest["pvalue"],3), 
                      type = names(cox_results[1])),
      data.frame(group = rownames(cox_results[[2]]$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(cox_results[[2]]$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(cox_results[[2]]$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(cox_results[[2]]$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(cox_results[[2]]$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(cox_results[[2]]$waldtest["pvalue"],3),
                      type = names(cox_results[2])),
      data.frame(group = rownames(cox_results[[3]]$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(cox_results[[3]]$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(cox_results[[3]]$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(cox_results[[3]]$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(cox_results[[3]]$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(cox_results[[3]]$waldtest["pvalue"],3),
                      type = names(cox_results[3]))
)


hr_prop <- ggplot(plot_df_prop, aes(x = reorder(type,dplyr::desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Covariates")+
ylab("HR for PID groups")+
theme_classic()+
scale_y_log10()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_prop
```

```{r}
# Genomic data
gen <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/validation/CTcohorts/SuppInfo_Jammihal_NatCancer25.xlsx", sheet = 5)
```

```{r}
# ccRCC mutational driver genes 
GOI_IntOGen <- read_tsv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/data/IntOGen_DriverGenes_CCRCC.tsv")
GOI <- GOI_IntOGen$Symbol #n = 44

gen_selected <- gen %>% filter(Hugo_Symbol %in% GOI)
gen_selected <- gen %>% filter(Hugo_Symbol %in% c("BAP1", "PBRM1", "NF2"))

# Variants only with MODERATE or HIGH impact
gen_selected_fil <- gen_selected %>% filter(!Variant_Classification %in% c("3'UTR", "Silent", "Intron"))

se$BAP1_mut <- ifelse(se$UUID %in% (gen_selected_fil %>% filter(Hugo_Symbol == "BAP1") %>% pull(UUID)), 1, 0)
se$PBRM1_mut <- ifelse(se$UUID %in% (gen_selected_fil %>% filter(Hugo_Symbol == "PBRM1") %>% pull(UUID)), 1, 0)
```

```{r}
dittoBarPlot(se, var = "BAP1_mut", group.by = "TME_archetype")
dittoBarPlot(se, var = "PBRM1_mut", group.by = "TME_archetype")
```

```{r}
# Expression matrix (Combat corrected values)
exp_mat <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/validation/CTcohorts/Checkmate_Braun_NatMed_2020.xlsx", sheet = 5)

# Correct duplicate gene names
exp_mat_fil <- exp_mat %>%
  group_by(gene_name) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean))

exp_mat_fil <- exp_mat_fil %>% column_to_rownames("gene_name")


# Clinical data
clin <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/validation/CTcohorts/Checkmate_Braun_NatMed_2020.xlsx", sheet = 1)

clin_sub <- clin[clin$RNA_ID %in% colnames(exp_mat_fil),]

rownames(clin_sub) <- clin_sub$RNA_ID

exp_mat_fil <- exp_mat_fil[, rownames(clin_sub)]
```

```{r}
# Create SummarizedExperiment
se <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays = list(exp = as.matrix(exp_mat_fil)),
  colData = clin_sub,
  rowData = DataFrame(gene = rownames(exp_mat_fil), row.names = rownames(exp_mat_fil))
)

se
```


```{r}
# Nearest template prediction
library(CMScaller)

# Step 1: Prepare expression matrix (genes x samples, log2 scale)
exp_mat <- assays(se)$exp
log2_exp <- log2(exp_mat + 1)
expr_mat <- ematAdjust(log2_exp, method = "RLE")
rownames(expr_mat) <- rowData(se)$gene

# Step 2: Create subtype templates (Gene signatures)
names(MTORUP) <- rep("MTOR", length(MTORUP))
names(ICAMUP) <- rep("ICAM", length(ICAMUP))
keyup <- c(MTORUP, ICAMUP)

template_mat <- data.frame(class = factor(names(keyup)), 
           probe = unname(keyup))

# Step 3: Run NTP classification with permutations
ntp_result <- ntp(
  emat = expr_mat,           
  template = template_mat,
  distance = "cosine",
  nPerm = 1000,              
  seed = 22,                 
  nCores = 30,
  doPlot = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
library(survival)
library(dplyr)

# Prepare the survival dataframe
Cox_df <- as.data.frame(colData(se)) %>%
  dplyr::select(RNA_ID, TME_archetype, Arm) %>% 
  mutate(
    arm = factor(Arm, levels = c("EVEROLISMUS", "NIVOLUMAB")),
    OS_months = se$OS[match(RNA_ID, se$RNA_ID)],
    status_OS = se$OS_CNSR[match(RNA_ID, se$RNA_ID)]
  )

# List of TME groups (e.g., ICAM, MTOR, NOT)
tme_groups <- unique(Cox_df$TME_archetype)

# Run Cox model per TME group
cox_results <- lapply(tme_groups, function(group) {
  df_group <- Cox_df %>% filter(TME_archetype == group & !is.na(Arm))
  model <- coxph(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ Arm, data = df_group)
  summary(model)
  })

names(cox_results) <- tme_groups

plot_df_prop <- rbind(data.frame(group = rownames(cox_results[[1]]$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(cox_results[[1]]$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(cox_results[[1]]$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(cox_results[[1]]$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(cox_results[[1]]$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(cox_results[[1]]$waldtest["pvalue"],3), 
                      type = names(cox_results[1])),
      data.frame(group = rownames(cox_results[[2]]$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(cox_results[[2]]$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(cox_results[[2]]$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(cox_results[[2]]$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(cox_results[[2]]$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(cox_results[[2]]$waldtest["pvalue"],3),
                      type = names(cox_results[2])),
      data.frame(group = rownames(cox_results[[3]]$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(cox_results[[3]]$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(cox_results[[3]]$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(cox_results[[3]]$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(cox_results[[3]]$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(cox_results[[3]]$waldtest["pvalue"],3),
                      type = names(cox_results[3]))
)


hr_prop <- ggplot(plot_df_prop, aes(x = reorder(type,dplyr::desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Covariates")+
ylab("HR for PID groups")+
theme_classic()+
scale_y_log10()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_prop
```

```{r}
# Nearest template prediction
library(CMScaller)

# Step 1: Prepare expression matrix (genes x samples, log2 scale)
tpm_mat <- assays(CPTAC.clean)$tpm_unstrand 
log2_tpm <- log2(tpm_mat + 1)
expr_mat <- ematAdjust(log2_tpm, method = "RLE")
rownames(expr_mat) <- rowData(CPTAC.clean)$gene_name

# Step 2: Create subtype templates (Gene signatures)
names(MTORUP) <- rep("MTOR", length(MTORUP))
names(ICAMUP) <- rep("ICAM", length(ICAMUP))
keyup <- c(MTORUP, ICAMUP)

#names(NOTUP) <- rep("NOT", length(NOTUP))
#keyup <- c(MTORUP, ICAMUP, NOTUP)

template_mat <- data.frame(class = factor(names(keyup)), 
           probe = unname(keyup))

# Step 3: Run NTP classification with permutations
ntp_result <- ntp(
  emat = expr_mat,           
  template = template_mat,
  distance = "cosine",
  nPerm = 1000,              
  seed = 22,                 
  nCores = 30,
  doPlot = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
ntp_out <- ntp_result %>% rownames_to_column("PID") %>% mutate(group_predict = ifelse(FDR < 0.01, as.character(prediction), "NOT"))
```

```{r}
# Define GOI of interest
#GOI <- c("CA9", "GPX4", "HLA-DRA", "NFKB1", "CCND1", "HIF1A", "TP53", "MYC", "ICAM1", "PDK4", "NT5E", "SMARCA4", "PKM", "CD274", "MME", "IDH2", "EPAS1", "AURKA", "HAVCR2", "EGFR", "RPS6", "FLT1", "VHL", "RB1", "MTOR", "SLC2A1", "FH", "GLUD1", "CD44", "VIM")

GOI <- c("ICAM1", "CD44", "MTOR", "VHL")

GOI_rel <- GOI[GOI %in% rownames(vsd)]

#c("CA9", "KRT19", "GPX4", "HLA-DRA", "NFKB1", "CCND1", "HIF1A", "TP53", "MYC", "ICAM1", "PDK4", "NT5E", "SMARCA4", "PKM", "CD274", "MME", "IDH2", "EPAS1", "AURKA", "HAVCR2", "EGFR", "RPS6", "FLT1", "VHL", "RB1", "MTOR", "SLC2A1", "FH", "GLUD1", "CD44", "VIM")

# Define heatmap based on normalized counts 
## Option 1: size-factor normalized counts 
#df <- t(counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)[GOI,]) %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("PID")
## Option 2: vst counts
df <- t(assay(vsd)[GOI_rel,]) %>% as.data.frame 
df <- df %>% rownames_to_column("PID")

## Create heatmap body 
df$group_predict <- vsd$group_predict[match(df$PID, colnames(vsd))]

mat <- df %>% pivot_longer(cols = 2:(ncol(df)-1), names_to = "gene", values_to = "exprs") %>% group_by(group_predict, gene) %>% summarize(mean = mean(exprs))

ht <- mat %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "gene", values_from = "mean") %>% column_to_rownames("group_predict")

## Create row annotation 
anno <- df %>% dplyr::select(group_predict) %>% group_by(group_predict) %>% dplyr::count()
anno <- anno[match(anno$group_predict, rownames(ht)),]

## Print heatmap 
Heatmap(ht, name = "Mean Z-scores")

Heatmap(scale(ht), name = "Scaled mean Z-scores")+
  rowAnnotation(n = anno_barplot(anno$n, gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF")))+
  rowAnnotation(anno = anno_text(anno$group_predict))
```
